# vue-rtl-kit

> MIT-licensed Vue 3.3+ and Nuxt 3/4 toolkit for reactive RTL/LTR direction, scoped layouts, logical styles, locale-aware formatting, and simplified plain-text bidirectional isolation.

Install from npm with `npm install vue-rtl-kit` (requires Vue 3.3+ and Node 20.11+, with optional Nuxt 3/4 support via `vue-rtl-kit/nuxt`).

BidiText is not a rich-text engine or a complete Unicode bidi algorithm implementation. Explicit initial `dir`, `setDirection()`, and `toggleDirection()` pin root direction against later locale changes. The toolkit does not translate messages or automatically convert an entire interface to RTL.

## Start here

- [English documentation](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/): Project overview and shared FAQ.
- [Getting started](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/getting-started): npm installation and Vue/Nuxt setup.
- [API reference](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/api): Exported functions, components, directives, and TypeScript types.
- [Full text reference](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/llms-full.txt): Substantive setup, behavioral contracts, limitations, examples, and bilingual source links.

## Direction and integration

- [Direction store](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/direction-store): Reactive state, pinning, document sync, and standalone state.
- [createRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/create-rtl): Vue plugin configuration and cleanup.
- [useDirection](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-direction): Nearest scope, root, or detached fallback.
- [useRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-rtl): Root store access; requires the installed plugin.
- [RtlProvider](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/rtl-provider): Local direction and locale scopes.
- [v-rtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/v-rtl): Element direction, optional isolation, SSR, and cleanup.
- [v-digits](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/v-digits): Normalize digits as users type or paste into Vue form fields.
- [Nuxt module](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/nuxt-module): Nuxt 3/4 setup and registration caveats.
- [SSR without Nuxt](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/ssr): Manual Vue SSR shells, server-safe rendering, and document attributes.

## Text, layout, and formatting

- [BidiText](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/bidi-text): Plain-text run isolation and rich-markup limits.
- [Text helpers](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/text-helpers): isolate, isolateRuns, splitBidiRuns, direction detection, and locale resolution.
- [useLogicalStyles](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-logical-styles): JavaScript style conversion and mirrored offsets.
- [CSS utilities](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/css-utilities): Optional logical spacing, positioning, borders, text isolation, and icon helpers.
- [Browser support](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/browser-support): Support floors, :dir() and scale fallbacks, and toPhysicalStyle targets.
- [useFormat](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/guide/use-format): Scope-aware Intl numbers, currencies, dates, and numbering systems.

## Arabic documentation

- [التوثيق بالعربية](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/): نظرة عامة وأسئلة شائعة.
- [ابدأ الآن](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/getting-started): التثبيت من npm وإعداد Vue وNuxt.
- [مرجع API](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/api): الصادرات والأنواع.
- [مخزن الاتجاه](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/direction-store): الحالة والتثبيت وSSR.
- [createRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/create-rtl): خيارات الإضافة.
- [useDirection](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/use-direction): أقرب نطاق اتجاه.
- [useRtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/use-rtl): الوصول إلى مخزن الجذر.
- [RtlProvider](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/rtl-provider): نطاقات مستقلة.
- [v-rtl](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/v-rtl): اتجاه العنصر والعزل.
- [v-digits](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/v-digits): توحيد شكل الأرقام عند الكتابة أو اللصق في حقول الإدخال.
- [وحدة Nuxt](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/nuxt-module): الإعداد والعرض على الخادم.
- [SSR بدون Nuxt](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/ssr): هيكل Vue SSR يدوي وعرض آمن على الخادم وسمات المستند.
- [BidiText](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/bidi-text): عزل النص العادي وحدود الوسوم الغنية.
- [دوال النص](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/text-helpers): isolate وisolateRuns وsplitBidiRuns وكشف الاتجاه واستنتاج اتجاه اللغة.
- [useLogicalStyles](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/use-logical-styles): الأنماط المنطقية في JavaScript.
- [أدوات CSS](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/css-utilities): أدوات تخطيط اختيارية.
- [دعم المتصفحات](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/browser-support): حدود الدعم وبدائل :dir() وscale وأهداف toPhysicalStyle.
- [useFormat](https://marwanmaher0.github.io/vue-rtl-kit/ar/guide/use-format): تنسيق حسب اللغة.
